phrase.zh: 许多耳朵，合成一幅天空。
phrase.en: Many dishes combine a view of the sky.

visual.zh: 数座碟形天线朝向夜空，弧线在其间汇聚，把看不见的无线电信号变成可见的连接。天线位置不是实际阵列坐标。
visual.en: Several dish antennas face the night sky while arcs converge between them, visualizing invisible radio signals. Their positions are not the coordinates of a real array.

background.zh: 美国甚大天线阵列由 27 座碟形天线共同观测自然无线电波。各天线收集的信号经计算合成，让阵列像一台更有分辨能力的望远镜；图片不表示真实接收波形。
background.en: The Very Large Array uses 27 dishes to observe natural radio waves. Computer processing combines their signals so the array acts as a more resolving telescope; the painting does not show received waveforms.
